case.test: requires a human session and same-origin consent, enforces tenant scope/CAS and restores opt-out

command: manifest argv from scripts/ci/gate-manifest.mjs wave6-browser for the case, then node scripts/ci/wave6-gates.mjs --case wave6-756bde47cd4150de --report <report>
environment: Native Darwin ARM64, Node 22.23.3; owned J1 default stack (Supabase Auth, Kong, Supavisor, PostgreSQL) on a private CA with SPKI-pinned edge; Google Chrome 155 for fixture sign-in.
fixture: Two fresh admins in separate workspaces. Admin A enrolled TOTP through /account/mfa/enrol and verified it, so the captured session is AAL2. Cookie and env files stayed 0600 in the runtime directory and are not recorded.
priorFailure: The first run on the same stack used an AAL1 cookie and failed: the privileged consent returned 403 mfa_required instead of the expected 400. That is correct product behavior; the fixture was fixed, not the product.
result: 1 passed / 0 failed. With the 3 PostgreSQL optimizer-settings cases (8776af2f), all 4 wave6 cases gated on COST-01/02/03 pass.
limits: All 4 cases exercise optimizer consent only (default off, human AAL2 session, same-origin, tenant scope, CAS, opt-out). They do not test the dated price catalog (COST-01), placement cost completeness or infeasible-budget refusal (COST-02), or measurable, nonflapping savings (COST-03). No requirement is promoted.
